column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way I Wouldn't Help My Little Sister
Kirino... Are you... all right?
...Those people know me.
But... I don't know them. I don't know them at all...!
Hey, have I really... lost my memories?
It's no good... It's completely useless... I can't remember them at all!
...Kirino.
Kirino... She looks like she's really frustrated. That's... only natural.
She's already disturbed about losing her memories, and now she can't remember about her warm and caring friends.
This girl treasures her friends a lot, so she probably can't forgive herself for that.
Tch... there's no helping it. I'll encourage her as her elder brother just this once...
Ah well, forget it.
I mean, what's with them? They just one-sidedly continued their conversation without thinking about my circumstances too. Way too
inconsiderate.
No... I don't want to be told that by you of all people.
This is why I hate otaku.
Those kind of people can't be 【my friends】.
Kirino's attitude angering me is nothing out of the ordinary, so I won't comment about it now.
But... just now, what did she just say?
